response.overview: # The Floor  Tells the story of Adda (Ezzanie Jasny), a university student struggling to continue her life after her scholarship money is misused by her own father, Malik. With her family's financial situation deteriorating, Adda is forced to work hard to support their needs. However, the harder she tries, the deeper she sinks into a darker side of life. Everything changes when Adda is introduced to "The Floor," an elite world filled with luxury, parties and influential people. Initially she refuses, but life's pressures eventually lead her to choose to lead a double life as a high-class companion woman for money. At the same time, Adda becomes caught in a conflict between two step-siblings, Annas (Lorenzo Irman) and Zakwan (Arfie Shah). While Zakwan uses her to destroy his own brother, Annas begins to see her as more than just a woman being exploited. But in a world filled with secrets and falsehoods, is there still room for them to be saved?
